decision_rule: Full HIP gfx90a build qualification only: exact v10 base, source diff and generated headers; linked llama-server contains adaptive environment, context, journal schema and poison markers. CMake requires HIP ON, backend DL OFF, ROCm Clang, gfx90a and enum-constexpr compatibility flag. All hash-bound llama/ggml libraries resolve locally, including libggml-hip; require exact defined code exports iqk_mul_mat and ggml_iqk_try_mul_mat from CPU library and ggml_backend_cuda_reg from HIP library plus compiled gfx90a image marker. Smoke compiles transformed server and reproduces IQK enum-constexpr failure then passes identical source with compatibility flag. Stop on validated full receipt; futility on build, identity, linkage or control failure, STOP or deadline. No native model, residency, identity, speed or P9 verdict.
